name: Cleric Wonder Worker
body:
The wonder worker possesses the ability to channel divine power without the need to study long hours in a temple, memorize a faith’s dogma, or apprentice to a spiritual teacher. Their powers seem innate except that wonder workers believe their abilities come from their strong devotion to a deity or fundamental idea.

Single Devotion

A wonder worker chooses only one domain from her deity’s portfolio rather than the normal two domains.

Healing Hands

A wonder worker does not gain the ability to spontaneously cast cure or inflict spells by sacrificing prepared spells (except as noted below). However, a wonder worker can spontaneously cast the following spells by sacrificing a prepared spell of the noted level or above:

1st level—remove sickness
2nd level—remove paralysis
3rd level—remove blindness/deafness
4th level—neutralize poison
5th level—raise dead
6th level—heal
7th level—greater restoration
8th level—mass cure critical wounds
9th level—true resurrection

Miracle (Sp)

At 5th level, the wonder worker chooses one domain spell she can cast. She may cast this spell once per day as a spell-like ability.

At 8th level and every 3 levels thereafter, she may choose another domain spell she can cast once per day as a spell-like ability.
